The Financial Services market is a key priority for Sopra Steria. This sector encompasses a robust client portfolio, including leading banks, insurance companies, social secretaries, and mutuality companies. Financial Services is also a focal point for our Consulting activities, offering substantial growth opportunities as our clients navigate diverse stages of their digital transformation journeys. 

As part of the Consulting Business Line at Sopra Steria, you will play a pivotal role within the Financial Services Community. Collaborating with a network of peers, you will contribute to or lead efforts such as crafting proposals, developing service offerings, sharing industry insights, and driving internal projects. 

Your primary focus will be client engagements, which will constitute the majority of your time. These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams. 

As a Senior Consultant or Manager, you will take ownership of complex assignments, manage client relationships, develop and apply managerial skills, and support business development activities. Leveraging on your industry expertise, your responsibilities on specific projects may include project and change management, Agile/Scrum facilitation, business and functional analysis, or architectural design

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:   

Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience in Consulting, working with clients in the Financial Services industry.

Industry Knowledge: strong understanding of business processes in one or more of the following sectors: large banks, insurance companies, social security organizations, and/or mutuality companies.

Digital Transformation: demonstrated experience in contributing to or leading digital transformation initiatives for clients, combining deep industry knowledge with a strong affinity for digitalization and IT.

Areas of Expertise: demonstrated skills in one or more of the following domains: IT Advisory (Target Operating Models), Project Management, Business/Functional Analysis, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Architectural Design, ESG, or Product Management. 

Additional Knowledge: familiarity with topics such as Open Finance, Instant Payments, AI in Financial Services, ESG, or cloud migration strategies are a plus.

Certifications: recognized certifications such as Prince2, TOGAF/Archimate, Leading SAFe, or Lean Six Sigma are advantageous. 

Consulting Mindset: strong ability to build and maintain trustworthy client relationships, familiarity with business development approaches, and a strong connection to the Consulting "motherhouse".

Languages: fluency in English and either French or Dutch is required.

Profile

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

Are you a technically skilled engineer with a passion for pharmaceutical processes? As a Project Engineer, you will contribute to various engineering projects. You’ll be responsible for the full project lifecycle of specific installations or equipment: from specification and procurement to installation, validation, and handover to operations. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams, monitor planning and budget, and ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution. You’ll also be part of creating technical solutions and be included in the technical follow-up with suppliers. You take ownership of your scope, communicate proactively with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Thanks to your strong technical insight, you are able to read technical plans with ease.

• Others describe you as someone who works accurately and is a true team player.

• You have either a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English.

At Terumo, we advance lifesaving medical technologies to benefit society. Are you eager to make a difference with us? Here, you'll grow your expertise while staying true to your personal aspirations.

Guided by our Japanese heritage, we act with respect, take ownership, and pursue continuous improvement. If you see yourself in our values, keep reading; this might be the opportunity you're looking for.
Department Info

Terumo is a global manufacturer of medical devices, with a strong production footprint in Leuven, where approximately 800 million hypodermic needles and injection solutions are produced annually.  Within the Pharmaceutical Solutions department, we focus on highly customized products developed according to the specific needs, medicines and questions of our pharmaceutical customers. To enable this high level of personalization, Terumo has invested heavily in flexible, highly automated production technologies. Our site proudly carries the title
 Factory of the Future
, recognizing both our advanced production environment and our people-oriented culture. As Senior Production Process Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional production team where engineering, quality, maintenance and operations work closely together to continuously improve processes, yield and quality.
Job Summary
As a Senior Production Process Engineer, you analyze, develop and implement improvements in highly automated production processes to sustainably increase quality, yield and efficiency. You thrive in a dynamic environment where initiative, problem‑solving and collaboration are key. Acting as a bridge between production and projects, you contribute from concept to stable implementation.
Job Responsibilities
 
 
•  Analyze existing production processes to identify, test and implement improvements, and resolve current issues  
•  Optimize production systems with a strong focus on OEE, quality and yield  
•  Define, implement and safeguard process standards, including CP and CPK monitoring  
•  Identify, prioritize and analyze bottlenecks using data-driven insights and structured problem-solving methodologies  
•  Define success criteria and ensure thorough root cause analyses of production issues  
•  Develop, coordinate and implement cross-functional improvement initiatives, ensuring sustainable results  
•  Take an active role in change management through training, procedures and clear communication  
•  Implement and optimize digital systems to monitor and analyze production performance  
•  Act as the link between production and project teams for new installations, from initiation through aftercare  
•  Manage the complete COC process and lead p-FMEA activities, ensuring feedback to SIPOC  
•  Prepare and actively participate in daily production meetings, supporting operational follow-up  
•  Contribute to TPM activities, including maintenance planning and execution  
•  Support calibration activities and perform MSAs  
•  Safeguard inspection readiness and ensure compliance with audit requirements  
•  Participate in internal and external audits, as well as client visits  

 
 
• Master's degree in Electromechanics or equivalent, or a Bachelor's degree with additional relevant experience 
• At least 5 years of experience in production environments with fully automated assembly lines 
• Strong knowledge of process expertise (technology & delivery base, implementation, risks), process control tools (such as 6S), engineering studies and process capability 
•  Basic knowledge of statistics and data analysis  
•  Six Sigma certification (minimum Green Belt)  
• Affinity with PLCs, robotics, cobots, AI or industrial engineering 
•  Open to change and motivated to continuously learn new skills  
•  Proactive in tackling challenges and finding solutions when outcomes are not immediately clear  
• Excellent communication, organizational and project management skills 
• Natural team player who enjoys cross-functional collaboration 
• Fluent in Dutch and English

• Encourage collaboration and learning, without owning delivery or operational outcomes
• Translate Sopra Steria’s strategic objectives into meaningful context for your people.
• Help employees understand how they can grow within the broader organization and what opportunities lie ahead.
Impact of the role

• As a People Manager Java, you are a catalyst for individual growth and engagement.
• You make a direct impact on people’s careers, motivation, and sense of belonging.
• You ensure that talent feels supported, can develop, and remains engaged with Sopra Steria.
• Your success is reflected in strong relationships, personal growth, and long-term retention.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware memory/storage subsystems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 

We are looking for an experienced Memory/Storage Engineer/Researcher to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong R&D background in memory and/or storage subsystem architecture or design in a larger compute system, with relevant academic/industry experience. We will expect you to bridge the gap between memory/storage technology and architecture to lead deep-tech research ideas towards high-impact innovations in our team.
 

What you will do
 
 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in applications, technology, circuits and design (across imec) towards R&D of novel memory/storage solutions in a system. 

• Conduct feasibility studies through performance modeling and prototyping to provide insights on the design and implementation of next-gen memory/storage subsystems. 

• Engage in R&D activities within project teams to take research ideas towards higher maturity levels, solving hands-on technical and engineering challenges in the process. 

• Develop and customize memory and/or storage subsystem models (functional and/or performance) for complex SoCs/systems for various application domains, as needed. 

• Stay up to date with the advancements in memory/storage subsystems across current domains, specifically in terms of novel technologies, design, integration paradigms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed. 

• Supervise or assist in mentoring Masters/Doctoral students/interns when necessary, and contribute to improved ways of working and shared knowledge across CSA. 

• Publish relevant results and artefacts in high-impact journals, conferences, seminars and open-source ecosystems to highlight CSA contributions to the community. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with hands-on memory/storage architecture/design experience. 

• You have 3+ years of R&D experience in the industry in architecting and/or designing memory/storage components and/or compute-near-memory/storage compute engines; 

• You have been actively involved through ideation to innovation/productization in one or more of your experiences in architecting and/or designing memory subsystems. 

• You have a deep understanding of memory/storage architecture and design principles, with experience in system-level performance modeling and analysis methodologies. 

• You have hands-on expertise in high-level performance modeling (C/C++, systemc, gem5, etc.) and/or low-level prototyping (EDA tools, ASIC design flows, etc.). 

• You have familiarity and/or experience with memory/storage technology innovations and/or memory interfaces/controllers and/or compute-near-memory/storage engines. 

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence. 

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership. 

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges. 

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

Your impact as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

The Utilities market is in full transition. At Sopra Steria, we are enthusiastically participating in the digital acceleration within this sector through our Industry and Services market. We aim to grow our advisory agency for Utilities, helping our clients efficiently deal with both current and future challenges in energy transition and sustainable resource management by optimizing processes, improving asset utilization, and enhancing customer experiences.

Your role & responsibilities as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. Your role will be key in architecting digital solutions and strategies that put our clients at the forefront of the energy transition and smart utility management in a rapidly evolving market while driving the growth of our advisory services.

• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for energy, water, and waste management utilities.
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as (Transformation consulting, cybersecurity, Data & AI, applications & integrations, cloud & infrastructure).

• Actively contribute to growing our advisory agency by identifying new opportunities and expanding our client base in the utilities sector.
• 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
